**Issue #3563 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #3563: Patch: Stinkyscape+ E9, random cards are unique
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

Part of fullsend 1 of the Stinkyscape+ set (#3534, tracker #3533). It builds the owner's system change: **every randomly generated card aims to be unique**, with repeats only when the pool runs out.

No card part needs it, so it builds beside the engine chain (E1→E8) instead of after it. If it collides with a chain part on the integration branch, it is parked and the reconcile merges it.

The plan: [`docs/stinkyscape-plus-set.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9/docs/stinkyscape-plus-set.md) (SP3 E9, SP5, SP8); the designer's list: [`JackiOh_StinkyscapePlus_Cards.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9/JackiOh_StinkyscapePlus_Cards.md). Both are on `main` once the foundation (#3535) merges. Where they disagree with SPEC, SPEC wins (CLAUDE.md).

## The owner's words (2026-11-09)

> system change as a whole all random generated cards should aim for UNIQUE unless there are no other options which then there can be duplicates. You can remove the unique wording

## The build (change a default only with a ruling note)

- Every effect that generates random cards (adds to a hand, summons, Discovers, fills a hand or a board, shuffles into a deck, casts) draws them **unique within that one effect**. No card comes twice until the pool has no unused card left; only then may it repeat, again drawing evenly from the whole pool. **Default:** "unique" means a distinct catalog card (the same card's base and Radiant faces count as one). Cards already in a hand or deck don't count against it.
- The engine's random-card pools (`catalog`'s pools, `with_pool_hold`, R2201001) draw without replacement within one effect, from the game's `Rng`, so replays stay deterministic. A Discover's three offers were already distinct. Make sure every other path goes through the same draw: `add random`, `summon random`, `fill`, `cast random`, and the Marketplace's offers within a turn.
- No card needs to say "unique" any more. #96 Open Enrollment and #97 Selective Enrollment lose the word (the foundation writes their text without it), and any shipped card text that says "unique" for a random draw loses it too (`card-text.yaml`).
- This reaches every shipped card that makes random cards, so it changes how they play. Record it in `spec/pending/<this issue>.md` and in §6.3's random-card wording. The release's fragment claims it as a rule (`cargo jackioh patches … --rule`), and the release re-blesses the golden traces and re-pins the seed-pinned tests.

## Done when

- [ ] The rule is written into §6.3 (and §10's randomness), with a ruling note numbered in this issue's block, a test named after it, and the paragraph in `spec/pending/<this issue>.md` (CLAUDE.md rule 3).
- [ ] Fixture tests in `crates/engine/tests/rules*` prove two things: an effect that adds N cards from a pool of at least N gives N distinct cards over many seeds, and one drawing from a smaller pool repeats only after every card was used once.
- [ ] Every random-card path in the engine draws through it. The cards' tests that pinned a seed are re-pinned where it moved them, not loosened.
- [ ] `cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo jackioh spec check`, `catalog check` and `fuzz --seeds 200` pass. `golden check` is re-blessed in the release (R), not here.

Blocked by #3535

Part of #3534.
```
